concepts.gloss_en: The eating of Shabbat (the act/food of Sabbath eating; source of blessing for the six days, holiness in which the Other Side has no share)

reason_for_human: All four occurrences are the identical construct אֲכִילַת שַׁבָּת (same vocalization, same meaning) discussing Shabbat eating as blessing-source and holiness. The 'בשעת' variant is just the same phrase with a temporal prefix ('at the time of Shabbat eating'), not a distinct concept. No homograph or article/archetype split is present.
